observations: Torah #112 is a single-sentence aphorism about strengthening oneself despite past damage. It contains no bechina language and no conceptual-equivalence statements. The concepts present (emunah/belief, kilkul/damage, tikkun/repair, hitchazkut/strengthening) relate to each other through cause-and-effect logic, not shared-nature parallels. There are fewer than 3 bechina-connected concepts, so no new package can be proposed.
